rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func that implements `fak conflation-scorecard`, folding internal/conflationscore's findings into the shared scorecard control-pane payload.
rows.distinction: Scores CONFLATION debt (a value reported as measured/WITNESSED that is really only claimed) specifically - not any other cmd*Scorecard sibling verb, each of which folds a different internal package's findings.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func that implements the agentic-coding loop-index scorecard: derives each loop stage's witness probes (orient/plan/act/verify/ship/learn) from the tracked tree and folds them into loopindex_debt via internal/loopindex.Score.
rows.distinction: Scores LOOP-INDEX stage-witness coverage across the orient-plan-act-verify-ship-learn stages - not milestone climb, not conflation provenance, not any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak milestone-scorecard` (issue #1444): folds the milestone report's maturity-CLIMB and epic-ROADMAP dimensions into a deterministic milestone_debt integer plus a worst-first retire worklist.
rows.distinction: Scores the milestone report's own climb+roadmap composite (milestone_debt) - distinct from internal/supportmaturityscore's support_maturity_debt, which it deliberately does not re-derive, and from any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak propagation-scorecard`: scores how far each proven scorecard convention (shared kernel, --compare, --markdown, ...) has fanned out across the whole scorecard family, via internal/propagationscore.
rows.distinction: Scores CONVENTION FAN-OUT across scorecards (a meta-scorecard about scorecards) - not any one scorecard's own debt, and not its sibling verb `fak propagation-debt-dispatch` (the fan-out ticketer defined in the same file).

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak repo-hygiene-scorecard`: runs the repo-hygiene fold over the git-tracked tree and can print the hygiene-debt delta vs a prior baseline.
rows.distinction: The CLI command func itself - not the general repo-hygiene-scorecard concept row (the measurement surface it implements), and not any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak skill-effectiveness-scorecard`: uses the shared scorecardCmdSetup front-half plus collectSkillEffectivenessScorecard to fold skill-effectiveness findings into the control-pane payload.
rows.distinction: Scores SKILL EFFECTIVENESS (whether declared skills are actually used/working) - not repo hygiene, not SOTA coverage, not any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak sota-coverage-scorecard` (internal/sotacoverage): with `--check` exits nonzero when there is any HARD sota-debt, evaluated for freshness against a `--today` date.
rows.distinction: Scores SOTA-COVERAGE freshness debt - not support-maturity, not token-defaults, not any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak support-maturity-scorecard` (internal/supportmaturityscore): folds declared-target shortfall per hardware/regime cell and can regenerate the HARDWARE-MATRIX.md matrix block via `--write-doc`.
rows.distinction: Scores declared-target SUPPORT-MATURITY shortfall per regime cell - distinct from milestone-scorecard's climb (which deliberately does not re-derive this scale) and from any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func for `fak token-defaults-scorecard`: derives every token-saving lever's on/off + witness state from entrypoint source (guard.go, serve.go, gateway Default* constants) and folds it into the token-defaults scorecard.
rows.distinction: Scores whether token-saving DEFAULTS are on out of the box and honestly witnessed - not SOTA coverage, not repo hygiene, not any sibling cmd*Scorecard verb.

rows.definition: The headline corpus integer (corpus.antipattern_debt) that internal/antipattern.Fold emits: the total count of detected anti-pattern findings, folding REDUNDANT_REWORK + UNWIRED_PKG + ORPHAN_FUNC from three previously-siloed detectors into one registry.
rows.distinction: ONE specific scorecard's *_debt integer (anti-pattern findings) - not the generic per-scorecard *_debt integer pattern, and not unwired_debt, the narrower package-only oracle it folds in as one of its three inputs.

rows.definition: The string field on milestonereport.GenerationRow (copied forward into operatorbrief's per-generation lane row) that joins WHY a lane's DebtScore is nonzero - e.g. stale issues or missing witnesses - into one human-readable reason string.
rows.distinction: The REASON TEXT explaining a debt score - not DebtScore itself (the integer it explains), and not any scorecard's single *_debt corpus key.

rows.definition: The int field on milestonereport.GenerationRow, computed as StaleIssues + 3*MissingWitnesses + 2*UnpromotedBets + 2*LabelShipMismatches, then copied forward into operatorbrief's per-generation lane debt.
rows.distinction: A PER-GENERATION-ROW composite integer - not the *_debt corpus key any one scorecard folds (e.g. milestone_debt), and not DebtReason, the text explaining it.

rows.definition: The internal/superloop MemberKind constant (value "scorecard") that tags a super-loop Member as a control-pane scorecard key, so the walk reads its status from the pinned baseline or a fresh run instead of a loop-health fold or a garden descend.
rows.distinction: One enum VALUE of MemberKind - not KindLoop, KindGarden, KindSuperloop, or KindSurface, the sibling member kinds declared in the same const block.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak Go func that implements the `fak product-scorecard` verb's body (invoked from main.go's product-scorecard dispatch and from score.go's "product" registry entry), taking stdout/stderr/argv and returning an exit code.
rows.distinction: The IMPL func for the product scorecard - not the productscorecard package's own pure build/fold core, and not any other cmd*Scorecard verb's run func.

rows.definition: The per-package Go string constant named ScorecardSchema (e.g. milestonereport.ScorecardSchema = "fak-milestone-scorecard/1", independently redeclared in internal/guardrsi and internal/issuefanout) that tags a scorecard.Payload with its control-pane schema id.
rows.distinction: The SCHEMA-ID constant on a payload - not DebtKey (the debt-integer key constant declared alongside it in the same files) and not the payload's runtime corpus map.

rows.definition: The headline corpus integer (corpus.unwired_debt) that internal/unwiredscore.Build folds: a count of code-complete internal packages imported by no .go file, via the package-granularity oracle.
rows.distinction: The NARROW package-only orphan count - not antipattern_debt, which later folds unwired_debt's UNWIRED_PKG class as one of three inputs alongside REDUNDANT_REWORK and ORPHAN_FUNC.
